descriptors.label: Object shape
descriptors.notes: Spawn only; existing object shape is immutable. food_marker/food_source alias food. Food has modeled odor/contact, no collision; toys use collidable palettes.

descriptors.label: Box position
descriptors.notes: World XYZ mm, not a floor snap. Supplied pose can intersect ground. Move preserves omitted coordinates; resize does not adjust Z.

descriptors.label: Box size
descriptors.notes: Full XYZ lengths; Swift common size form sends equal components, so anisotropy is backend-only. UI min .1 differs from backend .2.

descriptors.label: Sphere position
descriptors.notes: World XYZ mm, not a floor snap. Supplied pose can intersect ground. Move preserves omitted coordinates; resize does not adjust Z.

descriptors.label: Sphere size
descriptors.notes: Scalar diameter; applied size_mm is equal3 vector. Lists use first component; malformed supplied scalar falls back to3 (absent sphere default5).

descriptors.label: Wall position
descriptors.notes: World XYZ mm, not a floor snap. Supplied pose can intersect ground. Move preserves omitted coordinates; resize does not adjust Z.

descriptors.label: Wall size
descriptors.notes: Full XYZ lengths; Swift common size form sends equal components, so anisotropy is backend-only. UI min .1 differs from backend .2.

descriptors.label: Food position
descriptors.notes: World XYZ mm, not a floor snap. Supplied pose can intersect ground. Move preserves omitted coordinates; resize does not adjust Z.

descriptors.label: Food size
descriptors.notes: Scalar diameter; applied size_mm is equal3 vector. Lists use first component; malformed supplied scalar falls back to3 (absent sphere default5).

descriptors.label: Car position
descriptors.notes: World XYZ mm, not a floor snap. Supplied pose can intersect ground. Move preserves omitted coordinates; resize does not adjust Z. Absent spawn pose is [40,0,.205*length] for car; [40,0,.3*side+4] for trap. UI toy spawn computes Z; backend accepts explicit Z.

descriptors.label: Car size
descriptors.notes: Scalar length/side. Applied car dimensions [L,.44L,.41L], trap [L,L,.6L]. Spawn is strict scalar or len1; resize legacy clamps/uses first vector component. No Z adjustment on resize.

descriptors.label: Trap position
descriptors.notes: World XYZ mm, not a floor snap. Supplied pose can intersect ground. Move preserves omitted coordinates; resize does not adjust Z. Absent spawn pose is [40,0,.205*length] for car; [40,0,.3*side+4] for trap. UI toy spawn computes Z; backend accepts explicit Z.

descriptors.label: Trap size
descriptors.notes: Scalar length/side. Applied car dimensions [L,.44L,.41L], trap [L,L,.6L]. Spawn is strict scalar or len1; resize legacy clamps/uses first vector component. No Z adjustment on resize.

descriptors.label: Object yaw
descriptors.notes: REQUEST bounds: clamp to [-36000,36000], then modulo360. APPLIED range [0,360). All shapes; rotation around Z only, no tilt. Swift command/form has no yaw field; food rotates visually, is noncollidable.

descriptors.label: Food variant
descriptors.notes: Absent variant rotates deterministically in choices order. Spawn-only; no existing-food variant setter, generic spawn_object ignores variant. State field food_variant; sugar is derived, not editable. UI has no selector.

descriptors.label: Temperature
descriptors.notes: Backend stores 0..50C; Swift UI/coordinator clamp10..40C and currently activate locally before ACK. environment_only records only; modeled_physiology uses Swift tempo (no TRN); flywire_sensory uses modeled TRN_VP2/VP3a+VP3b current (no legacy temperature tempo override). No Python direct neural input.

descriptors.label: Temperature mode
descriptors.notes: Backend stores 0..50C; Swift UI/coordinator clamp10..40C and currently activate locally before ACK. environment_only records only; modeled_physiology uses Swift tempo (no TRN); flywire_sensory uses modeled TRN_VP2/VP3a+VP3b current (no legacy temperature tempo override). No Python direct neural input.

descriptors.label: Wind strength
descriptors.notes: Dimensionless, not m/s. Flags independently gate thorax mass*10000mm/s2*strength force and modeled JO-C/E current. Initial off; UI form .7. Zero stops timer/continuous. Scene candidate only for authored continuous wind, not active puff.

descriptors.label: Wind direction
descriptors.notes: REQUEST clamp [-36000,36000], then modulo360; APPLIED [0,360). 0 points +X,90 +Y; world horizontal force direction, not meteorological wind-from. UI remainder may be negative. Neural model uses body-relative direction; no food odor advection.

descriptors.label: Continuous wind
descriptors.notes: Contextual request default: wind infers duration_ms absent; wind_puff defaults false. Applied true only if strength>0. Initial false. Scene candidate only for deliberate continuous settings; active timers are not scene settings.

descriptors.label: Wind puff duration
descriptors.notes: Finite puff only; absent on wind implies continuous unless overridden. Continuous ignores duration. Active state contains remaining_ms, NOT authored duration. UI generic ms allows60000; backend clamps10000. Timer is simulation-time.

descriptors.label: Wind physical enabled
descriptors.notes: Independent boolean request flag; state uses physical_enabled. Both true initially. stop_wind retains flags/direction; scene candidate only for continuous wind configuration.

descriptors.label: Wind sensory enabled
descriptors.notes: Independent boolean request flag; state uses sensory_enabled. Both true initially. stop_wind retains flags/direction; scene candidate only for continuous wind configuration.

descriptors.label: Left eye enabled
descriptors.notes: Disabled or mask1 blacks actual eye frames; partial mask multiplies by1-mask. No direct neural probe. UI cover/restore sends mask endpoints only; enabled and fractional mask are backend-only. restore_eyes resets both enabled/masks.

descriptors.label: Left eye mask
descriptors.notes: Disabled or mask1 blacks actual eye frames; partial mask multiplies by1-mask. No direct neural probe. UI cover/restore sends mask endpoints only; enabled and fractional mask are backend-only. restore_eyes resets both enabled/masks.

descriptors.label: Right eye enabled
descriptors.notes: Disabled or mask1 blacks actual eye frames; partial mask multiplies by1-mask. No direct neural probe. UI cover/restore sends mask endpoints only; enabled and fractional mask are backend-only. restore_eyes resets both enabled/masks.

descriptors.label: Right eye mask
descriptors.notes: Disabled or mask1 blacks actual eye frames; partial mask multiplies by1-mask. No direct neural probe. UI cover/restore sends mask endpoints only; enabled and fractional mask are backend-only. restore_eyes resets both enabled/masks.

descriptors.label: Touch target
descriptors.notes: Unbound nominal targets include legacy leg aliases. Bound export filters resolved force-body targets. Physical specificity is body-part; neural channel is generic JO-A/B-like, not selected-part mapping. No persistent touch state.

descriptors.label: Touch strength
descriptors.notes: Physical force always enabled: mass*16000mm/s2*strength. No physical:false switch. UI default .55; sensory flag independently controls generic modeled touch channel.

descriptors.label: Touch duration
descriptors.notes: Backend default20ms versus UI150ms; UI generic maximum60000, backend clamps1000. Simulation-time active remaining timer is transient, not authored persistent duration.

descriptors.label: Touch direction
descriptors.notes: Unit-direction APPLIED component bounds. Legacy REQUEST accepts/coerces a 3-vector then normalizes; zero/invalid falls back [0,1,0], not strict component rejection. Hidden by Swift command/form. This descriptor does not authorize or tighten mutation.

descriptors.label: Touch sensory enabled
descriptors.notes: Backend-only option; physical force remains on. Generic modeled sensory drive, not direct neural stimulation or selected-part neural mapping.

descriptors.label: Flash eye
descriptors.notes: Brightness telemetry only: max(current,intensity) for selected eyes. Preserves looming; no real illumination or photoreceptor neural connection. Simulation-time pulse, never scene lighting.

descriptors.label: Flash intensity
descriptors.notes: Brightness telemetry only: max(current,intensity) for selected eyes. Preserves looming; no real illumination or photoreceptor neural connection. Simulation-time pulse, never scene lighting. Zero stops without live timer.

descriptors.label: Flash duration
descriptors.notes: Brightness telemetry only: max(current,intensity) for selected eyes. Preserves looming; no real illumination or photoreceptor neural connection. Simulation-time pulse, never scene lighting. UI generic maximum60000; backend clamps5000.

descriptors.label: Approach speed
descriptors.notes: Moves object toward snapshotted fly XY, not scripted fly locomotion. UI speed default12mm/s. Task is transient; completed authored object pose is separately a scene candidate.

descriptors.label: Approach end distance
descriptors.notes: Moves object toward snapshotted fly XY, not scripted fly locomotion. UI speed default12mm/s. Task is transient; completed authored object pose is separately a scene candidate.

descriptors.label: Car drive speed
descriptors.notes: Car-only transient action; actual strict legacy domain is 0 < value <= max (lower bound exclusive). Held car cannot drive. No active drive/task persistence.

descriptors.label: Car drive distance
descriptors.notes: Car-only transient action; actual strict legacy domain is 0 < value <= max (lower bound exclusive). Held car cannot drive. No active drive/task persistence.
